overview_description.description: Outrove builds a system that uses artificial intelligence for hiring. The system talks to job candidates through voice and video. It connects with meeting tools to ask questions in real time. The service finds people for open roles and sends them interview invites. The system manages communication, follow-ups, and scheduling. It gives reports after interviews to help companies decide who to hire.
